description: A tall, house-shaped tower of colorful magnetic tiles sits on the desk, with extra triangles and squares nearby. The left hand steadies the tower while the right hand repeatedly pinches off triangular roof pieces from the front and top, lifting them up and setting them to the right; then both hands pull away square panels and the top square so the tower collapses into a shorter open box, after which the right hand removes more tiles from the box and spreads the loose squares and triangles out across the tabletop.
